# Elementor
> Elementor is a visual WordPress website builder and managed hosting platform. It enables web creators to design responsive websites, landing pages, and online stores without writing code, while offering advanced CSS and styling controls for developers.

## Core Products & Themes
- [Elementor Manage](https://elementor.com/products/manage/): The central dashboard for managing Elementor websites and subscriptions.
- [Elementor Themes](https://elementor.com/themes/): The official repository of Elementor-compatible WordPress themes.
- [Hello Theme](https://elementor.com/themes/hello-theme/): Elementor's lightweight, blank-canvas WordPress theme designed for optimal performance.
- [Hello Biz](https://elementor.com/themes/hello-biz/): A business-focused variation of the Hello Theme.

## Features & Developer Roadmap
- [Variables Manager](https://elementor.com/roadmap/variables-manager/): Manage global design tokens and CSS variables across your website.
- [Custom CSS](https://elementor.com/roadmap/custom-css-2/): Advanced controls for adding custom CSS directly to widgets and pages.
- [Nested Tabs](https://elementor.com/roadmap/nested-tabs-2/): Create complex layouts by placing widgets inside of tabbed content areas.
- [Blend Mode](https://elementor.com/roadmap/blend-mode/): Apply Photoshop-like blend modes to backgrounds and elements.
- [Interactions](https://elementor.com/roadmap/interactions/): Build complex scroll and mouse-tracking animations.

## Add-ons & Integrations
- [Element Pack Pro](https://elementor.com/addons/element-pack-pro/): A premium library of advanced widgets and templates for Elementor.
- [Essential Addons](https://elementor.com/addons/essential-addons/): A popular suite of creative elements and extensions.
- [Image Optimizer by Elementor](https://elementor.com/addons/image-optimizer-by-elementor/): Native tool to compress and serve web-optimized images.
- [WP Umbrella](https://elementor.com/addons/wp-umbrella/): Integration for bulk WordPress site management and monitoring.
- [Site Mailer](https://elementor.com/addons/site-mailer/): Email delivery and SMTP management tool.

## Competitor Comparisons
- [Elementor vs. Hostinger vs. BlueHost](https://elementor.com/comparison/elementor-hosting-vs-hostinger-vs-bluehost/): A detailed breakdown comparing Elementor's managed hosting against traditional hosting providers.
- [Elementor vs. BlueHost](https://elementor.com/comparison/bluehost/): Comparison of features, speed, and pricing.
- [Elementor vs. Hostinger](https://elementor.com/comparison/hostinger/): Evaluation of Elementor's built-in hosting versus Hostinger.

## Professional Services (German / DACH Region)
- [Responsive Design Setup](https://elementor.com/service/responsive-design-setup/): Professional setup for mobile-responsive web design (Einrichtung des responsiven Designs).
- [Landing Page Creation](https://elementor.com/service/landing-page-creation/): Custom landing page design services (Landing Page Erstellung).
- [Priority Site Migration](https://elementor.com/service/priority-site-migration/): VIP service for migrating existing websites to Elementor Hosting.
- [Expert Consultation](https://elementor.com/service/consultation-with-an-expert/): One-on-one consulting with an Elementor expert.

## Interface Elements (Floating Buttons)
- [Floating Button Templates](https://elementor.com/e-floating-buttons/): A collection of pre-designed floating action buttons (FABs) for contact forms, chat, and navigation.
